boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Monterey Bay
boards.description: Ten named, under-21-safe food stops in Seaside and nearby Monterey County with currently published late service hours.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Fremont Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1830 Fremont Blvd, Seaside
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru when a late meal is needed; the official location page lists service through 3:00 a.m. every day.
cards.short_summary: A Seaside drive-thru with the latest listed closing time in this set.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-thru hours of 7:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. daily at 1830 Fremont Blvd in Seaside.
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 7:00 a.m.–3:00 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are earlier.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on Fremont Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1533 Fremont Blvd, Seaside
cards.notes: Plan on drive-thru service for the late window; its official page lists 24-hour drive-thru hours and a 10:00 p.m. lobby close.
cards.short_summary: A Seaside all-hours drive-thru, with earlier indoor access.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists its 1533 Fremont Blvd, Seaside drive-thru as 4:00 a.m.–4:00 a.m. daily and its lobby until 10:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1533 Fremont Blvd, Seaside
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed 24 hours daily; lobby is listed 6:00 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: In-N-Out Burger on Del Monte Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1350 Del Monte Blvd, Seaside
cards.notes: Choose this named Seaside restaurant for a late burger stop; the official location page lists 1:00 a.m. closes most nights and 1:30 a.m. Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.short_summary: Late evening dining and drive-thru in Seaside.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official page lists normal hours of 10:30 a.m.–1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and until 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1350 Del Monte Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Official normal hours run to 1:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 a.m. Friday–Saturday; drive-thru and dine-in are available.

cards.title: Wendy's on Fremont Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 1180 Fremont Blvd, Seaside
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: the official location page lists midnight closes most days and 1:00 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A Fremont Boulevard option with both restaurant and drive-thru late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until midnight Monday–Wednesday and Sunday, and until 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday, at 1180 Fremont Blvd.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru are listed until 12:00 a.m. most days and 1:00 a.m. Thursday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on Broadway Avenue
cards.subtitle: 1022 Broadway Ave, Suite B, Seaside
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm the day's close before ordering; it identifies this Seaside shop and lists service until midnight.
cards.short_summary: A named Seaside pizza pickup or delivery location with midnight listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official Marina location page identifies the nearby Seaside store at 1022 Broadway Ave, Suite B and lists it as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official Domino's page lists the nearby Seaside location as open until 12:00 a.m.; confirm availability for the selected order type.

cards.title: Domino's Pizza on Reservation Road
cards.subtitle: 265 Reservation Rd, Space Q, Marina
cards.notes: For a Marina pickup or delivery option, check the official store page; it lists this address as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Marina Domino's location with midnight listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino's official page lists its Marina shop at 265 Reservation Road, Space Q as open until 12:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the store open until 12:00 a.m.; verify pickup or delivery availability while ordering.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Alvarado Street
cards.subtitle: 321 Alvarado St, Monterey
cards.notes: Use the downtown Monterey location only when its current service window fits your plan; the official locator lists this named store as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A downtown Monterey Taco Bell with an official 1:00 a.m. listing.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location results identify the 321 Alvarado St, Monterey restaurant and list it as open until 1:00 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official locator lists this restaurant as open until 1:00 a.m.; verify the specific service mode before travel.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on Reservation Road
cards.subtitle: 211 Reservation Rd, Marina
cards.notes: Use the official restaurant page to check the active schedule before leaving; its locator identifies this Marina location near the CSUMB area.
cards.short_summary: A named Marina fast-food stop with an official location page.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official Seaside page identifies a nearby location at 211 Reservation Rd in Marina.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 211 Reservation Rd, Marina
cards.access_notes: Confirm current drive-thru and lobby hours on the official store page before making a late trip.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on Abrego Street
cards.subtitle: 889 Abrego St, Monterey
cards.notes: For a late Monterey option, review the official location page before heading out; it identifies this specific Abrego Street restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A named Monterey Jack in the Box location.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official Seaside page identifies a nearby location at 889 Abrego St in Monterey.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 889 Abrego St, Monterey
cards.access_notes: Confirm current drive-thru and lobby hours on the official store page before making a late trip.

cards.title: Jack in the Box on Canyon Del Rey Boulevard
cards.subtitle: 435 Canyon Del Rey Blvd, Del Rey Oaks
cards.notes: Keep this for a Friday or Saturday late drive-thru stop; the official page lists midnight drive-thru closing on those two nights.
cards.short_summary: A Del Rey Oaks drive-thru whose official listing reaches midnight on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box lists drive-thru hours until 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday at 435 Canyon Del Rey Blvd in Del Rey Oaks.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 435 Canyon Del Rey Blvd, Del Rey Oaks
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is listed until 12:00 a.m. Friday and Saturday; lobby hours are earlier.

warnings: Late hours may change, including for holidays; each card’s access note identifies the published service window or directs a current official check.
